The main takeaway from our work is that
the complexity of ray-shooting queries depends only on the complexity of the query segment, and does not depend on the complexity of obstacles.
, in order to answer ray shooting queries efficiently, it is sufficient to preprocess the data in a way that is tailored to the local geometry of the obstacles near the query.
, in the context of ray shooting, the simple cover complexity is a good parameter for measuring the complexity of the query geometry.
